headline: StoneX Raises Brazil Grain Production Forecast Despite Climate Challenges
summary: Consultancy StoneX raised its forecast for Brazil's soybean, cotton, and corn harvest to a record 184.95 million tonnes, up 0.9% from its previous estimate, despite lingering El Niño climate risks.
why: Brazil is a global agricultural superpower; revisions to its grain harvest forecasts directly influence international crop prices and trade flows.

impacts.name: StoneX Group
impacts.why: Upgraded agricultural forecasts reflect broader market activity in commodity consulting.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upward revisions to major crop production estimates in a key exporting nation alter global supply outlooks and can pressure soft commodity prices.
